title: Undergraduate Education Regulation, Article 12 (Make-up exams)
text: Make-up exams. A student who misses a midterm exam may take the make-up exam only with a documented excuse, such as a medical report. The document must be handed in to the student affairs office within 3 working days after the missed exam. Make-up exams are held in the make-up week of the academic calendar.

title: Undergraduate Education Regulation, Article 9 (Withdrawal from a course)
text: Withdrawal from a course. A student may withdraw from a course until the last day to withdraw announced in the academic calendar of that term. The course appears on the transcript with the grade W. A withdrawal cannot be cancelled.
